       RESPONSE TO SOAH ORDER #30 AND UPDATED EXHIBIT LIST FOR
             CHRISTOPHER LANDGRAF, PRO SE INTERVENOR
I am Christopher Landgraf, pro se intervenor. I am identified as Party Number 113 in

SOAH Order #30. In that order, Attachment A states ‘Ex A through F. Add testimony as

Ex G.’ next to my name in the ‘Exhibits’ column. I attempted to get clarification on this

statement during the pre-hearing call, but I wasn’t able to do so before the pre-hearing

call moved to other topics. We were encouraged to file motions to attempt resolution so

that’s what I’m attempting to do with this. On 6/3/2026, I uploaded my direct testimony

(which included Exhibits A through F in it) as Exhibit 1 to Kiteworks and Egnyte. I am

updating my exhibit list to reference Exhibits A through G, with G being pages 1 through

19 of my direct testimony and uploading it along with separate files for Exhibits A

through F to Kiteworks and Egnyte (that’s my best guess on what is being asked of me).

I am not adding new information and am just attempting to comply with SOAH Order

 #30. Exhibit 1 and the original Exhibit List that I uploaded to Kiteworks and Egnyte on

updated direct testimony on 5093 (which removed Exhibits G through I following

applicant objections in 4726 and was uploaded prior to SOAH Order #20 which denied

applicant’s motions to strike), and original exhibit list on 5477.
